column1: # Local computing-voucher and subsidy rules, a second set, with the same columns as tables/local_vouchers.tsv. 217 rows, one per rule or other document read (application notices, drafts and accounts of a rule among them; tables/local_vouchers_classes.tsv says which rows are counted and why the others are not). Rows 47 to 217, in the file's order, were added on Nov 25, 2026: rows 47 to 54 from readings earlier that day, rows 55 to 102 from a search for voucher rules across the 31 province-level governments and 24 named cities and new areas (districts and other cities only as they turned up); rows 103 to 216 from a fourth and a fifth round of the same day: four searches that went city by city and their second passes, a search for the earlier versions of the rules that favour home-made computing, readings of named rules, and pages saved then; row 217 from a sixth round of the same day, which read again the cells a third reading of the official record had queried and searched for the implementing rules of Shenyang's and Dalian's vouchers. The rows are the rules found by searches that went province by province and city by city, saved and read, not a census of every local government. Columns: body = issuer as the page's own title or signature names it; level; date = date signed or published on the page (in force from / to where the page says); document = title and number on the page; rate_home = share paid for home-made (国产 / 自主 / 全国产化) compute; rate_other = share paid for other compute; kind = voucher on rented compute, construction or purchase subsidy, one-off reward, or plan; words = the exact words carrying the rates (each checked by script against the saved copy, or against text extracted from it where the copy is a Word file or the page's text extraction lost the passage; in row B211, which is not counted, read by eye on a scanned file with no text layer, as its copy cell says); saved_id; copy = what the saved copy is; cuts = which way it cuts for the position (a home-made premium or home-made-only support is FOR; paying for foreign or any compute is AGAINST). Source: the saved pages named. English is ours.
